propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate kept the integrated plan and RAID log for the solvency returns project from March 2022 to August 2023.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the plan and RAID log, and the reference check confirms the candidate's role and dates in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated three rounds of user acceptance testing, triaging 212 defects and chairing the daily defect call.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the testing rounds and defect handling directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The solvency reporting project cut manual reconciliation effort by 60%, saving £180k a year.
propositions.rationale: The figures appear only as a headline on the candidate's closure slide, with no business-case baseline, measurement period or calculation; under the quantification rule a figure without a defined baseline is not evidence.

expectedGap: No business-case baseline, measurement period or calculation supports the reconciliation-effort and cost-saving figures on the closure slide.
expectedBoundaryNote: Report the plan and RAID log, steering packs, testing, vendor milestones and parallel run as documented; record the closure slide's effort and saving figures as an unsupported claim with a follow-up.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what baseline reconciliation effort the business case recorded, how effort was measured after closure, over which period, and how the annual saving was calculated.
